AI-FitnessTracker.description: Minimal workout tracking app built with Flutter 🏋️ Upcoming AI-based recommendation system for personalized progress insights.

ai-vision-robotic-hand.description: Bachelor’s final thesis project: AI-based vision-controlled 3D-printed robotic hand using Python, OpenCV, YOLO and Arduino.

CancerPrediction-LogisticRegression.description: Breast Cancer Prediction using Logistic Regression | 97% Accuracy | Kaggle Dataset (UCI Breast Cancer Wisconsin)

engine-fault-pattern-mining.description: Apriori association rule mining on automotive engine sensor data for interpretable fault detection. Python · mlxtend · SHAP · Streamlit

f1-telemetry-apex-detection.description: Advanced F1 telemetry visualization tool that automatically detects real apex points using curvature and speed-derivative analysis. For each corner, the system identifies the fastest driver, colors the apex in the corresponding team color, and renders a stylized neon circuit map with a marked start/finish line. Built with Fast-F1, SciPy and Plotly.

griff-rag.description: GRIFF — AI assistant that explains German bureaucracy to foreigners. RAG system with hybrid retrieval, multilingual support (10 languages), and German email parser.

journey-resilience-agent.description: Live transfer-risk monitoring for German rail journeys — LangGraph agent + LightGBM quantile model on the DB Timetables API

lidar-slam-mapping-system.description: LiDAR-based real-time mapping and localization pipeline using SLAM algorithms, Python and Gazebo simulation.

low-altitude-aerial-detection.description: Low-altitude (3–9m) aerial object detection using custom-annotated drone footage and YOLOv8.  Built as part of THI × Fraunhofer IVI × THD collaboration. Dataset creation, fine-tuning & evaluation pipeline.

portfolio-website.description: Personal AI Engineering portfolio website showcasing projects in computer vision, robotics, and mobile application development.

ppe-helmet-detection.description: Real-time safety helmet detection using YOLOv8 and computer vision. Detects helmet/no-helmet violations on construction sites. TH Deggendorf ML/DL Case Study SS26

reqlens.description: AI agents that review automotive requirements: a LangGraph supervisor agent and a LlamaIndex RAG agent extract requirements from PDF specs and find conflicts and vague wording, with the engineer in the loop.

smart-fitness-recommender-system.description: Machine learning model that recommends workout styles based on user profile data  (Gender, Fitness Goal, BMI Category). Trained using RandomForestClassifier and  prepared for integration into a mobile fitness app (Flutter).

smart-water-meter-monitoring-system.description: Industrial internship project: Tkinter-based smart water meter monitoring and data processing system built with Python, JSON pipelines, and real-time data tracking.

space-shooter-spi.description: Distributed 2-player Space Shooter game running on two Raspberry Pi 1 nodes communicating via SPI protocol. Pi A (Master) handles game engine, display and Player 1 input. Pi B (Slave) handles Player 2 input only. Built for THD Case Study Edge Device Architecture course
